name: addiction
quote: He can't go a day without whiskey.
description: A strong desire for a psychoactive substance.

variations.name: something you really like
variations.description: In common usage, 'addiction' just mean a 'strong desire' as in being 'addicted' to peanut butter. But when there's nothing psychoactive involved, it's really just a strong desire or appreciation.

variations.name: chemical addiction
variations.description: When it involves brain chemicals as in the case of drugs or alcohol 'addiction' means dealing with pain or threat of pain from withdrawal symptoms.

commentaries.quote: If you're struggling with an addiction that's causing problems, you should consider seeking help.

conditions: The body perceives that it is not receiving enough of a certain expected chemical, causing discomfort and a desire to fill the gap.
